query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.role, u.status, mp.id as profileId, mp.stageName, mp.genre, mp.location, mp.rating, mp.verified 
FROM users u 
LEFT JOIN musician_profiles mp ON u.id = mp.userId 
WHERE u.name LIKE '%rani%' OR mp.stageName LIKE '%rani%';
